artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: fixture index-population guard added and verified; premise reconciliation and three unrelated pre-existing gate-set exclusions recorded with evidence and issue IDs.

completion_data.completion_summary: Converted test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh's fixture-staging invariant into a mechanically enforced index-population assertion, verified via lint/positive-run/negative-probe. The dispatch's named cause was already fixed before dispatch; recorded as a stale-premise issue rather than re-applied. Both phases closed COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS after discharging the complete verify-deploy.sh gate set, which fails 3 of 37 checks for three independent pre-existing causes unrelated to this task, each evidenced and issue-tracked.

memory_candidates.content: To prove a verify-deploy.sh gate failure is pre-existing and not caused by your own edit, run the pristine (pre-your-commit) copy of the affected script against the identical live-repo state and compare: if both reproduce the identical failure byte-for-byte, the cause is proven unrelated. Use `git show <prior-commit>:<path> > scratch-copy` or temporarily swap the file content in place, run, then restore -- never leave the swap uncommitted.

verify-deploy.sh Gate 20's eager-load regression check (current eager-loaded CLAUDE.md+rules bytes vs. a recorded baseline in orchestrator-context-budget.json) is an UNCONDITIONAL fail-tier check -- it ignores ORCHESTRATOR_BUDGET_GATE_MODE (warn/hard, which only governs the per-file ceiling checks) and is NOT skipped by --skip-slow or narrowed by --only-gate for other gates; it fires on every full-battery or --only-gate 20 invocation whenever the live repo's eager context has drifted over baseline, independent of any fixture or target.
